nodes.label: Standards + client request register (doc 19)
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth, binding for every task; update in the same turn when a request or rule changes.

nodes.label: A. Quality standard
nodes.rationale: Audience is the client's decision makers; job is a pitch for more work; every frame art-directed.

nodes.label: One idea per transition/effect
nodes.rationale: Describable in one sentence; reject anything reading as 'effects thrown at it'.

nodes.label: Generate from the client's own material
nodes.rationale: Never redraw what the client already has (photos, vector KV, neon video).

nodes.label: Verification: 100% frames + sphere + motion clip
nodes.rationale: Compared against the reference; only then show it.

nodes.label: B. Client request register (sphere opening)
C1 Green text not yellow
nodes.rationale: Client: 'Se ve amarillo en vez de verde algunas palabras' (Cambios 1). Meaning: all green text = KV #7FFF00, glow UNDER the letters. Status: done v13 (mg/mg.html).

nodes.label: C2 Pentagon point up on every KV ball
nodes.rationale: Client: ball appears 'en otro espacio' / start the pentagon 'con la punta mirando hacia arriba'. Meaning: front pentagon point UP on every KV ball, opening and closing; back points down (true geometry). Status: done opening v13, closing v14 (was missed until Nov 24). Where: RZ_UP everywhere ball_field is used.

nodes.label: C3 Closing = client's own neon sequence
nodes.rationale: Client: 'Este hombre de negro no... tiene q ser como la referencia... todo el KV en verde' + 'silueta de la persona que chuta con los halos de luces'. Meaning: closing uses the client's own neon sequence (Higgsfield 242e14fe, 4K) fitted to the circle in code, NOT regenerated. Status: done v14 (tools/esfera/closing_circ.py, K_neon.mp4).

nodes.label: C3a Fill the poles, no empty stripes
nodes.rationale: User: fill the poles, no empty stripes. Meaning: circle = full video height (sides trimmed). Status: done v14.

nodes.label: C3b Stop video where ball lines match KV ball
nodes.rationale: User: stop the video exactly where the ball lines match the KV ball. Meaning: push-in + freeze on frame 139, KV ball takes over on its seams; back copy rolled 36 deg. Status: done v14 (K_neon.mp4, KICK_BACK_ROT).

nodes.label: C4 Truck visible in J1
nodes.rationale: Client: 'Aqui es importante q se vea el camion como esta en el video'. Meaning: client's white tanker visible in J1 driving to horizon; puma + beam STAY. Status: done v14 (J1_anim.mp4, Higgsfield 72fa9c2c).

nodes.label: C4a Truck to ship at same size and spot
nodes.rationale: User: truck->ship at same size and spot as J2 tanker. Meaning: truck width = ship width at the change (measured). Status: done v14 (panel flip, CLIP_DELAY).

nodes.label: C4b Land-to-sea transition
nodes.rationale: User: improve truck->sea transition, 'land to sea'. Meaning: one continuous generated shot, road becomes sea, truck silhouette becomes tanker; start/end frames in review_esfera/upload_transicion/. Status: in progress, waiting for generation.

nodes.label: C4c Tide overlay transition (rejected)
nodes.rationale: Code 'tide' overlay transition: flat water, white blob glint, streak, panel-grid flash. Status: rejected Nov 24 (TIDE = False); don't repeat.

nodes.label: C5 Globe not flat, Paraguay outline matches
nodes.rationale: Client: map 'muy planito' + Paraguay outline must match background and not look flat. Meaning: night-earth texture; Paraguay traced on texture's own borders; neon outline + inner glow. Status: done v14 (geo/py_tex_mask.png).

nodes.label: C5a Paraguay filled with horizontal light beam
nodes.rationale: User: fill Paraguay with a horizontal moving light beam; text smaller and higher so full outline visible. Meaning: horizontal laser strands + sweep; cfg_py yTop 0.10, widths x0.75; zoom 3.6. Status: done v14.

nodes.label: C6 Beam lower, puma on beam centre
nodes.rationale: User: beam lower, puma stepping on the beam's centre. Meaning: PATH_B 33 deg, paws on centre line through the gallop. Status: done v14 (PUMA_FOOT, PUMA_DROP).

nodes.label: C7 White silhouette puma at entrances
nodes.rationale: Client: white silhouette of the puma 'when it comes in at the beginning and at the end'. Meaning: ONLY logo entrances, start (logo 10.0 s) and end (cat_in 59.2 s); beam puma stays CHROME. Status: done v15 (cat_run_in(), Higgsfield 72d5cd51).

nodes.label: C7x Silhouette replacing beam puma everywhere (rejected)
nodes.rationale: Misread of C7. Status: rejected Nov 24.

nodes.label: C8 2027 to full white to KV
nodes.rationale: Client request: 2027 -> full white -> KV. Status: done v13.

nodes.label: C9 Closing text contrast
nodes.rationale: Client: closing text bad contrast, 'basic and outdated'. Meaning: closing lines higher, ball darkens to deep emerald. Status: done v13.

nodes.label: C10 Photo collage (script p.13)
nodes.rationale: It IS a client request (script page 13). Status: in timeline.

nodes.label: C11 Truck turning into oil tanker
nodes.rationale: Was unconfirmed; now covered by C4a/C4b. Status: unconfirmed -> in progress.

C. User rules (permanent)
Rule: state credit cost first, no upscales before approval
Rule: prompts via skills, pasted in full (ZH+EN)
Rule: send files with SendUserFile
Rule: ignore vehicle-manufacturer badges
Rule: text/numbers static, no light on text, faces unchanged
Rule: renders one at a time; push only to gifted-shannon branch
Rule: short answers, one recommendation, say what's NOT done first
